prose: Roots and inner bark of indoor willow cuttings dried on the bakery oven top and ground in a porcelain mortar. Half a teaspoon steeped in boiling water reduces bunkhouse fevers and joint aches, though prolonged use causes severe gastric ulceration.

Synthesized in five-liter glass carboys by reacting scrap iron sulfate with industrial cyanide salts salvaged from the plating shop. Administered in three-gram oral capsules to scavengers returning from hot zones to bind radioactive cesium-137 in the digestive tract.

Crushed poppy capsules grown in the locked hydroponics quarantine bay, macerated for twenty days in 80-proof potato alcohol. Kept under triple padlocks in the chief surgeon's desk; used exclusively for traumatic amputations and terminal radiation hospice cases.

Standard wheat ration biscuits charred black in a closed iron retort and superheated with pressurized steam. Ground into a gritty black slurry and ingested within thirty minutes of drinking unverified cistern runoff to trap dissolved fallout isotopes before intestinal absorption.

Pure zinc metal filings burned in an air furnace to produce zinc oxide powder, then levigated with cold-pressed flaxseed oil and rendered mutton tallow. Spread generously over raw weeping beta burns and chemical dermatoses to prevent bacterial crusting.

Green segmented twigs of Ephedra sinica harvested from the Level 3 sand beds, boiled for forty minutes with dried orange peel. Given to boiler technicians during 36-hour emergency repair shifts to maintain respiratory drive and cognitive focus.

Blue-green mold cultured on sterilized damp cornmeal paste in flat petri dishes. The living mycelial mat is lifted with a spatula and bound directly against infected puncture wounds and shrapnel tracks. Highly effective against staphylococcal trench infections, though 5% of patients develop acute anaphylaxis.

Crushed eggshells and limestone dust dissolved in mild acetic acid and thickened with kelp agar. Rubbed immediately into the skin of engineers exposed to freon or fluorinated heat-exchange coolant leaks to prevent deep bone decalcification and systemic hypocalcemia.
